price_band_partition.needs: a sourced per-session NSE price-band payload (data/silver/price_bands is empty and data/raw holds no price-band archive either); the bands are not derived from prices, which would make the counter a restatement of the bar it tests

corporate_action_archive_coverage.reading: UNATTESTED_NO_RECORD means 'no record in this archive', not 'no corporate action': an instrument the archive does not cover at all cannot be exonerated by it (§10.5, N-200)

corpus.sha256_of: the file's stored bytes, unnormalised: a gzip stream is `-text` and has no LF form, so the raw digest is the only one a reader can reproduce and the one the manifest and the s100 comparison publish (N-204)

corpus_reconciliation.detail_scope: `reconciliation.ratio_shaped_detail` lists the 699 moves beyond ±0.35 whose one-session return is ratio-shaped within ±0.5% and carries no archive record. It is not a census of unadjusted level breaks: a move below the threshold is not listed, a move outside the ratio band is counted in `no_ratio_match` (74 rows), and a pair straddling a calendar gap (16194 pairs) is a gap record, not a session return. Absence from the list is not an exoneration (N-201).

entry_signal_scope: executable signals, as the runner resolves them: EQ on that session, in the point-in-time universe, and with a T+1 session to fill at (§7.1). The final session's predicate-and-universe signals are counted in `signals_without_a_next_session` (and the EQ ones in `signals_without_a_next_session_in_eq_series`), not dropped by the guard (§101.12 item 5).

feature_window_policy.attestation: the same test the stop uses: a price-side ratio on the exact ex-date, or a cash amount on the exact ex-date within 0.5% of the previous close
feature_window_policy.consequence: such signals are counted below and excluded from the usable-feature-window set; they do not extend the STOP class, which remains the signal-day −20% level-step test
feature_window_policy.rule: a signal whose own continuous 200-session feature window contains an unattested price level step of 10% or more, in either direction, does not count as a usable entry signal: SMA(200) and RSI(2) at that T are computed across a step the committed corporate-action archive cannot attest, which is the assumption §6.3 forbids one step removed from the day the stop inspects

gated_by.statement: no committed code outside this producer and the audit probe reads this artifact, so its STOP is a record of a refusal and not a gate: no execution path exists for it to refuse

limitations: the QA enumerates ratio shapes the way the corpus reconciliation does (1..12 over 1..24, ±0.5%); a non-empty list means a split or bonus of that shape would print exactly this return, not that one happened
the corpus's reconciliation publishes moves beyond ±35%, so a smaller unattested step is absent from `reconciliation.ratio_shaped_detail` and that absence is not an exoneration
the ADTV count is a per-signal counter: a name can be counted once per signal day it was excluded on, not once per name
the locked-session count reads the T+1 bar's high == low and the security master's band at T+1; it is the fill-blocking condition, not a claim about queue position

a move that happens inside a session whose opening price is continuous with the previous close is classified SESSION_MOVE and is not a corporate-action step: the exchange traded it, and the rule is pre-registered to buy that pullback. Only an opening gap beyond the threshold is a level step, and only an unattested level step stops the round
the opening-gap test uses the corpus's own adjusted open against the previous adjusted close, so an adjustment applied at the wrong date would show as a level step here

the lookback count is per signal: a name is counted once per signal day whose own 200-session window holds an unattested step, so it is not a trade count; the 10% threshold, the ₹5 previous-close floor and the 200-session window are recorded in `feature_window_policy`, not pre-registered values
method: the pre-registered entry condition (close > SMA(200) and RSI(2) < 10, Wilder, on split/bonus-adjusted closes) over the point-in-time universe, restricted to identities the exchange master resolves to EQ on that session; features partitioned into continuous subsegments exactly as the engine partitions them; counts and lists computed before any P&L is read

rights_terp_branch.limitation: the RIGHTS branch of the cash test reprices to the theoretical ex-rights price from an issue ratio and premium parsed out of free-text prose, and no rights record in the committed table sits on a candidate level step, so the branch has never fired on this corpus and its first real use will attest a price level against an unattested record with a regex-extracted number — that first use is not evidence (§101.3, §101.12 item 6)
